whenToUse: A Customer 360 page: health, MRR, pipeline, tickets and balance for one account.
Account managers who move deals, chase invoices and pin notes from one screen.
avoidWhen: A list of many accounts — use list-05.
A plain record layout without the CRM depth — use record-detail-layout.
a11y: One h1 names the account; invoices use a real table and the health chart is role="img".
History filters are keyboard operable; keep their labels explicit.
